// diagnostic

E0945

`toolchain:` comptime input read outside the toolchain tree's own packages

What

`toolchain:` comptime input read outside the toolchain tree's own packages

Why

Only the compiler workspace's members, and the packages they depend on inside the toolchain tree, read that tree; there is no built-in copy of it

Fix

Read the file beside this one, or build inside the toolchain tree with `JET_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT` set.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0945: tests/ui/comptime_embed_toolchain_outside_packages.stderr.

Error [jet.ToolchainInputOutsideTree]: `embed_file` reads `toolchain:Compiler/package.jet` outside the toolchain's packages
  --> tests/ui/comptime_embed_toolchain_outside_packages.jet:1:9
    |
  1 | D: #run embed_file("toolchain:Compiler/package.jet")
    |         ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: This file is in no package of the toolchain tree; only the compiler workspace's members and the packages they depend on inside that tree read it
 Fix: Name the file beside this one, `embed_file("Compiler/package.jet")`, and keep it in this package
